_comment: Single source of truth for the release facts that many documents restate and no generated manifest carries: the tag, the release date, the status label and the release-evidence totals. scripts/check_surface_counts.py reads this file and fails when a release-facing document states a different date, carries pre-release status wording after the status is SHIPPED, or quotes a CTest or VM-parity total that disagrees. Change a value here, run `python3 scripts/check_surface_counts.py --sync`, regenerate the site pages with scripts/build-site-content.sh, and the gate confirms nothing was missed. A null total means the figure has not been recorded yet: documents then render the claim without a number, and `--require-complete` fails until it is filled in. previous_tag names the release before this one: scripts/check_changelog_completeness.py walks `<previous_tag>..HEAD` and fails when a pull request merged in that range is neither referenced in the changelog section for the tag nor listed in tests/coverage/changelog_no_user_facing_change.json.
ctest_total_placeholder: PLACEHOLDER: replace the null above with the N of ctest's own '100% tests passed ... out of N' line from the full CTest run at the release commit, then run `python3 scripts/check_surface_counts.py --sync` and `scripts/build-site-content.sh`, and delete this key.

sources.previous_tag: the git tag of the preceding release; must resolve in a full-history checkout and be an ancestor of the release commit (scripts/check_changelog_completeness.py)
sources.ctest_total: ctest summary line of the full suite at the release commit (scripts/run_ctest_gate.sh)
sources.vm_parity_total: scripts/run_vm_parity.sh summary line at the release commit (vm_parity.jsonl, vm_parity_gate)
